Audit the current Next.js implementation of /our-works. Search breadth: very thorough.

Project root: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq`

Read these files fully:
1. `src/app/our-works/page.tsx`
2. `src/app/our-works/[slug]/page.tsx` (if exists)
3. `src/components/our-works/our-works-hero.tsx` + `.module.css`
4. `src/components/our-works/our-works-cta.tsx` + `.module.css`
5. `src/components/our-works/portfolio-card.tsx` + `.module.css`
6. `src/components/our-works/portfolio-filter.tsx` + `.module.css`
7. `src/components/our-works/portfolio-grid.tsx` + `.module.css`
8. `src/components/our-works/portfolio-popup.tsx` + `.module.css`

Also find:
- Any constants file used for portfolio items (search `src/lib/constants/` for portfolio/our-works data)
- Any TypeScript types (search `src/types/` for portfolio/our-works types)
- Any image assets in `public/images/webflow/` related to portfolio (count files)

Report (under 800 words):
1. **Page structure** — order of components rendered in `our-works/page.tsx`, server vs client components.
2. **Hero implementation** — what content, badges, layout. Note any deviations from Webflow.
3. **Filter implementation** — sidebar vs bar? search? category list source? active/disabled handling? state management (URL params? local state?).
4. **Portfolio grid** — columns, card height/width, breakpoints in CSS module.
5. **Card** — image, badge, eye icon, hover, click action.
6. **Pagination** — items per page, button styling.
7. **Popup** — iframe path? image gallery? close handling?
8. **CTA section** — content, padding.
9. **Constants/data** — how many portfolio items in code, are all 21 there? are images sourced from Webflow CDN or local?
10. **CSS module values** — quote padding, border-radius, font-size, box-shadow, breakpoints for each module file. Compare quickly to known Webflow values: cards 280px/400px/450px height, sidebar 305px, container 1300px, pagination 44px buttons, badge 20px radius.
11. **Issues / bugs / missing pieces** — list every gap: missing section, wrong size, wrong image, missing breakpoint, broken interaction, untyped state, hardcoded "any", wrong category list.
12. **Build readiness** — does `pnpm build` succeed currently? (don't run it — infer from code)

Be exhaustive. Quote line numbers and file paths in `path:line` format. Output a punch list of fixes needed.

## AUDIT REPORT: Next.js Implementation of `/our-works`

### 1. PAGE STRUCTURE
**our-works/page.tsx:19-29** renders:
- Server component (no "use client")
- JsonLd (breadcrumbs schema)
- WorkPageBg (background)
- OurWorksHero (client-rendered)
- PortfolioGrid (client component with full state management)
- OurWorksCta (client component)

No server-side data fetching; all 19 portfolio items + 8 categories live in client-side constants.

### 2. HERO IMPLEMENTATION
**our-works-hero.tsx:4-58** + **our-works-hero.module.css:1-267**
- Heading: 40px @ base, 1.9rem @ max-width:767px (portfolio.ts:line 5)
- 4 stat badges with icons (theme: navy + cyan gradient, white boxes with 20px padding)
- Badge pill: 20px border-radius, cyan gradient text (CSS:line 48-67)
- Desktop responsive: maintains 40px heading through 1440px
- Mobile: 2×2 grid badges with column flex (CSS:line 250-259)
- Matches Webflow exactly per CSS comments

**Issues found:**
- Missing breakpoint at 1920px+
- Badges use hardcoded paths `/images/webflow/Layer_1-*.svg` — no validation if files exist

### 3. FILTER IMPLEMENTATION
**portfolio-grid.tsx:16-278** (client component, "use client" @ line 1)
- **Layout:** Sidebar (0.4fr) + Grid (1fr) @ base; min-width:1280px → minmax(305px, 305px) + 1fr
- **Sidebar:** Sticky (top: 100px), sticky position disabled @ max-width:991px
- **Filter bar (header):** Search input + active tags + sort dropdown (hidden via aria-hidden div)
- **Category list:** From PORTFOLIO_CATEGORIES constant (portfolio.ts:199-212)
- **Search:** Local state (setSearchQuery), filters by name + category
- **Sort:** "name-asc" / "name-desc" — only 2 options, hardcoded
- **Active/disabled:** Coming Soon categories use `comingSoon: true` flag, disabled attribute on checkbox
- **State management:** useState hooks — no URL params (lost on refresh!)

**Critical issues:**
- **Filter state lost on page reload** — no URL search params, no localStorage. User sets filters → reload → all filters gone.
- Sort state frozen at "name-asc" (line 19: `const [sort] = useState<SortOption>("name-asc")` — no setter!)
- No clear button in header filter bar (only in sidebar, invisible on mobile)
- Missing `.comingSoonText` style composition in portfolio-filter.tsx (line 155 calls .comingSoonText but portfolio-filter.module.css:263 has `composes` on label only, not on span)

### 4. PORTFOLIO GRID
